given_when_then.given: A customer places an Order Request with items available at multiple Store Partners
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine processes the request
given_when_then.then: The system assigns the order to the nearest Store Partner with sufficient stock and creates a Fulfillment Task

given_when_then.given: A customer places an Order Request where no Store Partner has sufficient stock for all items
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine processes the request
given_when_then.then: the system does not assign the order and flags it for manual review without creating a Fulfillment Task

given_when_then.given: The system has identified a Fulfillment Task with sufficient inventory available at a Store Partner
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine assigns a Delivery Assignment with an Assigned Delivery Slot to the order
given_when_then.then: The Store Partner is notified via the assigned Delivery Slot of the new Fulfillment Task

success_criteria: The Store Partner is notified of the new Fulfillment Task via the assigned Delivery Slot
The nearest Store Partner with sufficient stock is selected for assignment
Inventory quantities reserved by an automatic assignment are immediately deducted from the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot
No Fulfillment Task is created if no store has sufficient inventory for the complete order
An order flagged for manual review is not assigned to any store
